answer: Super-linear capital expenditure forces each added Sybil node to consume n^2 of stake, while quadratic slashing ties penalties to collateral squared, ensuring marginal attack cost C(n)=a·n^2 surpasses maximal extractable value V_max≈b·n; thus any assault becomes economically irrational. The copper reserve, juniper collateral ledger, and bridge consensus layer embed these equations, guaranteeing equilibrium.
